hero.title: Let's get to know each other —

story.title: Mathilde,
story.p1: Mariable was born from a young bride's wish: to make wedding planning simpler, clearer and more joyful.
story.p2: Today, Mariable also serves wedding professionals thanks to Mathilde's expertise in AI. It is a wedding app 80% built with artificial intelligence.
story.p3: Mariable is a passion project, not my main activity: after entrepreneurship, I work as a Growth & AI consultant.

steps.title: Entrepreneurship & AI
steps.body: Solo founder of mariable.fr · Self-taught in AI & no-code · Growth Marketing certification. Now a Growth & AI consultant.

mission.missionBody: Not just making the wedding day easier, but elevating it: everyone gets the right information at the right time, so the couple can fully enjoy it.
mission.visionBody: A simple, modern and accessible app for couples and for the professionals who orchestrate their weddings.
